package.name: calib_axis_test
package.description: Diagnostic: tests whether the hand-eye calibration's ROTATION is correct (axis mapping / sign), not just its scale (already validated separately by calib_intrinsics_test). Commands fp3_hand by a known, pure, single-axis displacement and checks that the calibration tag's own position -- transformed into fp3_link0 THROUGH the calibration under test -- moves by the same vector, not just the same magnitude. A mismatch on the wrong axis or sign is direct evidence of a rotation bug in the calibration, which would produce a constant, same-direction lateral pick offset regardless of calibration quality/coverage.
